items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I know Errol Garner was down the street.

ctx.x: Yeah, I didn't remember the name of the hotel. It was -- this was when I played with Earl, though. It's right on the corner from the Grand Terrace. I didn't remember that name, but Lawrence Brown, all of them, they stayed at this hotel, lot of guys. I couldn't remember the name of it. I don't know if they call it the South Parkway Hotel or what hotel, but it was right on the corner.

There's a drug store downstairs, and we all used to go in there and eat breakfast. They had short order things. But 52nd Street was very interesting because every -- every room there had some kind of name or semi-name. They were just getting started then, you know, a lot of them. I know Errol Garner was down the street. He just hadn't come from Pittsburgh too long before. He was down there.
Of course, Dizzy Gillespie and that little group, he had together was (inaudible) those down there. And Eddie Haywood had a little group right next to where I was, nice little group.
